proof.text: Install the algebra structure induced by phi_0. Finite type over Noetherian gives finite presentation [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-noetherian-finite-presentation]. Use Mathlib Algebra.FiniteType.iff_quotient_mvPolynomial'' to obtain a surjective finite polynomial presentation C_0 -> A. Set Q=comap(C_0 -> A,q), C=(C_0)_Q and S=A_q. Construct the algebra map C -> S by Localization.AtPrime.algebraOfLiesOver. Prove it surjective by writing each element of S as a/s, lifting both a and s along the polynomial surjection, and noting that a lift of s outside q lies outside Q. This constructs the extension P:R -> C -> S without any unproved data.

C is Noetherian by [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra-noetherian] and [lem-weil-pbc-localization-noetherian]. It is formally smooth over R by the polynomial formally-smooth instance (recorded on [lem-weil-pbc-polynomial-ring-h1-cotangent-vanishing]) and Mathlib FormallySmooth.of_isLocalization and FormallySmooth.comp. It is essentially of finite type, so KaehlerDifferential.finite gives finite differentials. The kernel is finitely generated by Noetherianity; Mathlib Extension.Cotangent.finite makes P.Cotangent finite over S. Tensor base change makes P.CotangentSpace finite, and its flatness from formal smoothness makes it free over the local ring S by [lem-weil-pbc-finite-flat-local-free].

Apply [lem-weil-pbc-artinian-lifting-conormal-mod-maximal] to P and the hypothesis, obtaining a quotient retraction v. In the proved private helper residue_injective_of_split_quot, use TensorProduct.quotTensorEquivQuotSMul to identify tensoring with the residue field with quotient by the maximal ideal. Conjugate v through these equivalences. On a pure tensor with residue coefficient represented by r, its composite with the tensor conormal map equals the identity by the equation for v applied to r times x. Thus the tensor conormal map is injective.

Apply Mathlib IsLocalRing.split_injective_iff_lTensor_residueField_injective to P.cotangentComplex: the source is finite and the target finite free by step 2, so the conormal map has a left inverse. Mathlib Extension.formallySmooth_iff_split_injection gives formal smoothness of S over R. This is Algebra.IsSmoothAt R q. These are direct applications of the recorded Mathlib criteria; no completion theorem or Jacobi-Zariski theorem is used.

Use [lem-weil-pbc-smooth-at-prime-naive-cotangent-criterion] in its Mathlib form Algebra.IsSmoothAt.exists_notMem_smooth to obtain g outside q with A_g smooth over R. The affine comparison [lem-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map-iff-smooth-affine] makes Spec(A_g) -> Spec(R) smooth. Let j:Spec(A_g) -> Spec(A) be the principal open immersion [lem-weil-pbc-principal-localization-open-immersion, def-weil-open-immersion]. Its opensRange is D(g), which contains q. Transport smoothness along j.isoOpensRange, using [lem-weil-pbc-smooth-restrict-open-subschemes], to get Smooth(opensRange(j).iota composed with Spec(phi_0)). This supplies W with the original signature unchanged.

title: Reverse implication in the Artinian lifting criterion
statement:
Let $R$ be a Noetherian commutative ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], let $A$ be a commutative ring, let $\varphi_0:R\to A$ make $A$ a finitely generated $R$-algebra, and let $\mathfrak q$ be a prime ideal of $A$. Write $\pi=\operatorname{Spec}(\varphi_0)$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. A small extension is a surjective homomorphism $\varphi:B^{\prime}\to B$ of nonzero Artinian local commutative rings with kernel of module length one over $B^{\prime}$; write $\mathfrak m_B$ for the maximal ideal of $B$.

Assume: For every small extension $\varphi:B^{\prime}\to B$ and ring homomorphisms $\rho:R\to B^{\prime}$ and $a:A\to B$ such that $a\circ\varphi_0=\varphi\circ\rho$ and $a^{-1}(\mathfrak m_B)=\mathfrak q$, there is a ring homomorphism $a^{\prime}:A\to B^{\prime}$ with $\varphi\circ a^{\prime}=a$ and $a^{\prime}\circ\varphi_0=\rho$.

Then: There is an open subscheme $W$ of $\operatorname{Spec}A$ containing $\mathfrak q$ with $\pi|_W$ smooth [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms].

lean.statement:
theorem artinian_lifting_smooth_on_open_reverse
    {R A : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (φ₀ : R →+* A) (hfinite : φ₀.FiniteType) (q : Ideal A) [q.IsPrime] :
    (∀ (B' B : Type (max u v)) [CommRing B'] [CommRing B]
      [IsArtinianRing B'] [IsArtinianRing B] [IsLocalRing B'] [IsLocalRing B]
      (φ : B' →+* B), Function.Surjective φ → Module.length B' (RingHom.ker φ) = 1 →
      ∀ (ρ : R →+* B') (a : A →+* B),
        a.comp φ₀ = φ.comp ρ → Ideal.comap a (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B) = q →
        ∃ a' : A →+* B', φ.comp a' = a ∧ a'.comp φ₀ = ρ) →
    (∃ W : (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)).Opens,
      (⟨q, inferInstance⟩ : PrimeSpectrum A) ∈ W ∧
        Smooth (W.ι ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ₀)))
